---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: "type:feature"
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What problem does this feature solve?

## Proposed solution

Describe the expected behavior (what, not how to code it).  
You can use bullet points for key behaviors.

## Alternatives considered

What other options did you consider? Why is this one better?

## Acceptance criteria

Clear, testable conditions for this feature to be considered done.

Example:

- [ ] The "Export CSV" button is visible for users with role X.
- [ ] The file contains all currently filtered rows.
- [ ] Column headers match the displayed labels.
- [ ] Export works for 1 row and for 10,000 rows without errors.

## Technical notes (optional)

Relevant modules, endpoints, DB tables, or technical constraints.

## Additional context (optional)

Links, screenshots, mockups, discussions, or any other useful info.
